The '''Vurdon Ka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Darlonn sector/Legends|Darlonn sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vurdon Ka/Legends|Vurdon Ka]].
